ticket.subject: Feature request: deals in EUR and USD
ticket.body_text:
Dear Support Team,

I'm the operations manager at Hollowfen Media. We would like to keep deals in more than one currency in the same workspace.

We sell in the US and in Europe. Our reports would need to convert amounts at a fixed monthly rate.

Please consider it.

Kind regards,
Henrik Iversen

label_notes: clean feature (feature-multi-currency): a request for something the product does not do is P4; urgency low: no time pressure.
